title: The first projection evaluates an arbitrary supported kernel
statement: For the commutative condensed coefficient Lambda selected by l,c in [def-sfb-rational-tate-pullback-comparison], any scheme Y, module family L and Diagram d as in [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category], put P=P1_Y, W=P times_Y P, and R=Rq_*, U=Rp2_*, S=Rp1_*, A=p1*. The isomorphism firstPathComparison: UR -> SR is the inverse conjugate of the canonical comparison q*p2* -> q*p1* of [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]. For any M in D(P), N in D(W), alpha:source(Lambda,Y)[0] -> N, t:d.R1(N) -> unit(P), and invertible fixed projection pi_p1(M,N), the following equality holds. Start with R of the p2 section M -> U Delta_*M, then RU of the inverse diagonal tensor map followed by identity tensor supportedUnitIso.hom followed by alpha. Follow this by firstPathComparison at AM tensor N and R of inverse pi_p1(M,N), identity tensor the native realization of t, identity tensor singleUnitIso.hom, and the right unitor. This equals R of the right-unitor conjugate of identity_M tensor (singleUnitIso.inv, d.support1.hom, d.R1(alpha), t, singleUnitIso.hom). All arrows and their ordering are exactly the attached Lean statement. Neither d.delta, any specified trace, any integration equality, nor a finite-type geometric hypothesis is used. The coefficient is selected by l,c to keep the native interface fixed. The canonical realization of t is firstNativeFunctional, defined as eqToIso(d.p1_canonical).inv followed by t, with the definitional first-projection identification made explicit. The names firstKernelInsertion and firstTerminalFunctional are the two literal composite constructions, with endpoints fixed before applying R; their definitions contain these arrows, not existence-based choices.

source.place: First identity: change the two direct-image paths, move M outside the first projection, and cancel the diagonal section; arbitrary kernel and functional version.

proof.text: Use naturality of the canonical conjugate firstPathComparison to move the arbitrary arrow alpha across the path change. Apply naturality of the first projection with alpha, and cancel that projection against the inverse supplied by hp. This leaves only the supported-unit kernel and its section comparison.

Apply the section clause for Delta,p1 of ringedProjectionTensorComposition. The inverse diagonalTensorIso is the canonical section tensor map. Its transpose under the canonical pullback section is the coefficient right unitor. Compatibility of conjugation with composition identifies the p2 section followed by firstPathComparison with the q direct image of the p1 section. Thus the remaining supported-unit section is the right unitor inverse tensored with the canonical coefficient section.

The full universal-unit normalization of d.R1 and the ordinary composition normalization in d.support1 identify the coefficient section with singleUnitIso.inv followed by d.support1.hom. Projection naturality moves the arbitrary functional t outside. Combine the coefficient arrows with functoriality, and insert the two unitors. No diagonal integration equality or trace base-change relation is used.

theorem first_section_tensor_evaluation
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (L : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules (coefficient l c).X X) (d : Diagram (coefficient l c).X Y L)
    (M : DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)))
    (N : DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (α : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules (coefficient l c).X (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).obj
      (source (coefficient l c).X Y) ⟶ N)
    (t : d.R₁.R.obj N ⟶ unit (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (hp : IsIso (projectionMap (coefficient l c).X (firstProjection Y) M N)) :
    (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).map
        (firstKernelInsertion (coefficient l c).X Y M N α) ≫
      firstTerminalFunctional (coefficient l c).X Y L d M N t hp =
    (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).map
      ((ρ_ M).inv ≫ (M ◁
        ((singleUnitIso (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)).inv ≫ d.support₁.hom ≫
          d.R₁.R.map α ≫ t ≫ (singleUnitIso (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)).hom)) ≫
        (ρ_ M).hom)
